content.user_title: Analyze Data with Pandas and SQL
content.value_statement: Raw datasets can hide quality issues, trends, and weak assumptions. This skill guides profiling, cleaning, statistics, visualization, and reporting with reproducible steps.
actual_capabilities: Profiles CSV, JSON, SQL, and pandas datasets for structure and quality.
Suggests pandas and SQL steps for sampling, summaries, and aggregates.
Guides missing value handling, duplicate removal, type conversion, and outlier checks.
Calculates descriptive statistics, correlations, grouped metrics, and pivot tables.
Plans charts with matplotlib and seaborn for distributions, categories, correlations, and trends.
Structures reports with dataset overview, findings, statistics, and recommendations.
limitations: It needs accessible data, schema details, or representative samples from the user.
It does not guarantee statistical validity without domain context and assumption checks.
It does not replace privacy review for sensitive personal or regulated data.
It provides analysis guidance, but execution depends on the host tool environment.

use_cases.title: Profile a New Dataset
use_cases.description: Quickly inspect columns, data types, missing values, duplicates, and candidate analysis questions before deeper work.

use_cases.title: Prepare Decision Reports
use_cases.description: Turn raw metrics into clear findings, charts, statistical summaries, and practical recommendations for stakeholders.

use_cases.title: Validate Operational Data
use_cases.description: Check files or tables for quality issues, inconsistent categories, outliers, and gaps before reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Profile a CSV Dataset
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner exploration of a new file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to inspect my CSV. Summarize columns, data types, missing values, duplicates, and useful first questions.

prompt_templates.title: Clean and Validate Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to propose a cleaning plan. Cover missing values, duplicates, type conversion, outliers, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Find Statistical Insights
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis for trends and relationships.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to identify grouped metrics, correlations, trends, segments, and caveats for this dataset.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reproducible Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the data-analysis skill to design a reproducible analysis report with assumptions, visualizations, statistical summaries, key findings, and recommendations.

output_examples.input: Analyze a customer orders CSV for quality and revenue trends.
output_examples.output: The report includes row counts, missing value checks, duplicate checks, revenue by segment, monthly trend notes, and cleanup actions.

output_examples.input: Explore product sales by region and month.
output: Regional sales ranking with top and bottom performers.
Month-over-month trend summary with notable changes.
Recommended charts for comparison, trend, and distribution views.

output_examples.input: Check whether a dataset is ready for executive reporting.
output_examples.output: The analysis highlights schema gaps, inconsistent categories, outliers, missing dates, and assumptions that need validation before publication.

best_practices: Start with dataset structure and quality before modeling or recommendations.
Document assumptions, transformations, and validation checks throughout the analysis.
Use visualizations to confirm patterns found in summary statistics.
anti_patterns: Do not modify raw source data without keeping a preserved copy.
Do not publish sensitive personal data in examples, charts, or reports.
Do not present correlations or small samples as proven causes.

faq.question: What data formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports workflows for CSV, JSON, SQL tables, and pandas dataframes.

faq.question: Can it create charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides histogram, boxplot, heatmap, and time series chart planning with matplotlib and seaborn.

faq.question: Does it run the analysis automatically?
faq.answer: It provides steps and code-oriented guidance. Actual execution depends on the host tool and available files.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Use it carefully. Remove or mask personal data before sharing examples, charts, or reports.

faq.question: Can it work with SQL databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes schema inspection, sampling, aggregate statistics, grouping, and summary query guidance.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the dataset, schema, business question, column meanings, and any quality concerns.
